facts.text: Serve the mains when both families sit down together in Bali.
facts.why: The plot summaries opened show David and Georgia travelling to meet Gede's large family and helping prepare for the ceremonies, but none names a sit-down meal with both families together.
facts.fix: Serve the mains when David and Georgia meet Gede's family in Bali.

facts.text: A dolphin bit Georgia. This helps.
facts.why: David is the one bitten by a dolphin, on the swim Gede takes the Cottons on. The snake bite at Tanah Lot goes to Paul, the pilot. Georgia is not bitten.
facts.fix: A dolphin bit David. This helps.

facts.text: Lily wants to marry a seaweed farmer. David and I agree the seaweed salad is good. She's still not marrying him.
facts.why: Lily does marry Gede. David and Georgia give their blessing at the ceremony and the couple finish the wedding. The line also has Georgia agreeing about a seaweed salad, which no source shows.
facts.fix: Lily wants to marry a seaweed farmer. David and I tried to stop her. We lost, and the wedding was lovely.

fix_note.text: Lily wants to marry a seaweed farmer. David and I tried to stop her. We lost, and the wedding was lovely.

facts.text: The beach in Bali where Lily falls for Gede
facts.why: Lily and Wren are rescued at sea by Gede. They hit it off that night over dancing and the next morning at his seaweed work. No source places it on a beach.
facts.fix: The Bali night where Lily and Gede hit it off

facts.text: Beer pong rematch. Georgia and David, same team.
facts.why: David and Georgia do play beer pong together at a bar after the ring ceremony, which fits 'same team'. Nothing shows an earlier game, so 'rematch' is unclear.
facts.fix: Beer pong champions. Georgia and David, same team.

facts.text: A drinking game on the sand
facts.why: The beer pong is played at a bar on the island, not on the sand.
facts.fix: A beer pong game at the bar

vibe.verdict: Looks and tastes like a Bali warung, but the host note and the dolphin line get the plot wrong and the cue is a guess.
missing: Georgia and David stealing the couple's wedding rings (the Trojan horse plan)
Gede rescuing Lily and Wren at sea
Paul the pilot and his two proposals (snake bite at Tanah Lot)
Beer pong at the bar after the ring ceremony
The Balinese ceremony with the dagger through the pandan mat
David and Georgia jumping off the boat at the end
ideas: Swap the Bintang note for 'A dolphin bit David. This helps.'
Replace the 'The beach wedding' wink with 'Two stolen wedding rings, one Trojan horse plan'
Swap the satay description for a Tanah Lot snake bite joke ('Paul got bitten, the satay is safe')
Replace 'Pupu Platters' with a section named after the rescue at sea, such as 'Snorkel rescue snacks'
